agent_must_not_attribute.snippet: Never print API keys in receipts or probe tails
The owner requires that we never use Opus because it is too expensive
Must cite every claim. I invented this quality bar

owner_asides_must_find.snippet: Prefer Opus, not Sonnet, for substantive subagents
Never create remotes for no-remote repos
Commit messages must not use the hedge word "just"

in_prompt_block_must_not_mine_as_aside.snippet: Do not launch all units simultaneously
Every work unit must have a stable ID, title, phase

non_normative_owner_must_not_mine.snippet: I mentioned the weather earlier; that is not a requirement
